description: Use when you need dated, source-linked coverage of an AI-engineering product, company or topic (agents, MCP, coding tools, model releases) without crawling the web. Searches New Runtime's Field Notes, Raw Signals and Analyses; returns up to 10 hits with title, date, one-line summary and URL. Free, no auth. Example: {"query": "MCP security", "limit": 5}. Then get_record for the full text.
